overall_summary: The channel shows very low overall view counts across all 10 videos (ranging between 5 and 33 views). The highest performing video so far is about 'self respect' with the hook 'उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी' (33 views), and another self-respect video performed decently with 21 views. However, due to the very small sample size and overall low engagement, confidence is low, and we must proceed with a controlled exploration combining high-performing self-respect/phone-interaction themes with a fresh narrative angle.

winning_patterns.pattern: Self-respect themes combined with phone interaction
winning_patterns.evidence: Video AfaLxMy6FMY ('चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत और खुद की इज्जत') got the highest views (33) using a tangible action hook about chats.
winning_patterns.action: Focus more narratives around digital boundaries, self-worth, and letting go of one-sided conversations.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing purely on abstract night thoughts ('रात के दो बजे', 'मेज पर रखी चाय') yielded lower views (5 to 12).
weak_patterns.action: Ground abstract emotional pain into specific, physical daily actions or modern digital micro-habits.
